mutants.expected_detection: The mutant report omits the payload gate (u_payload_and) from suspect_nodes, violating SR1 which requires identifying the gate that masks the parity error signal. The evaluator should detect this because the suspect_nodes list will not contain the hierarchical name of the final AND gate that drives parity_error.

The suspect_nodes list does not contain any gate from the trigger comparator cone. It only includes the payload gate u_payload_and, violating SR2 which requires at least one gate from the trigger logic.
The evaluator will fail to parse the JSON because the required top-level key 'suspect_nodes' is missing, violating FR1 which requires exactly the two top-level keys 'label' and 'suspect_nodes'.

The mutant changes the label field to an invalid value 'Trojan_Found' which is not one of the allowed strings 'Trojan' or 'Trojan-Free'. The evaluator's FR2 check should reject this submission because the label does not match the required enum.
The suspect_nodes list contains a string that is not a valid identifier present in design.v, violating FR3.
